title: Protecting Eight Trigrams Sixty-Four Palms
body:
Syntax: perform protecting eight trigrams sixty-four palms [on|off]

Minimum level 75, Byakugan mastery 48% and inherited Potential 0 or higher. This toggles Byakugan or a short-lived defensive/celestial form. Higher modes have higher chakra upkeep. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
